summary.text: Victoria Gu is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 38 and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
A software engineer and data analyst by background, she has served in the Senate since January 3, 2023, succeeding Republican Dennis Algiere.

paragraphs.text: Victoria Gu graduated from South Kingstown High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Harvard University.
Her career experience includes working as a software engineer and data analyst, and she previously chaired Charlestown's Climate Resiliency Commission.
Gu assumed office in the Rhode Island State Senate on January 3, 2023, and her current term ends on January 5, 2027.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
